# failover-budget

Measure what DNS and GSLB failover actually costs, in the only unit that matters: what your users experience.

## What it does

Calculates user-visible recovery time from three terms:
- probe_detection = probe_interval x fall_threshold (when the LB notices)
- remaining_ttl = worst case, failure right after a resolver cached (full TTL)
- cache_propagation = resolver and client caches beyond TTL expiry

Also measures real DNS cache hold of a resolver using a minimal UDP DNS client (no dependencies).

## Key files

- failover_budget.py: main CLI tool, argparse, budget calculation, cache measurement, interactive mode
- runbook.py: operator runbook (7 steps) and diagnostic decision tree
- test_failover_budget.py: 34 tests

## CLI flags

- --probe-interval FLOAT: health probe interval in seconds (default: 5)
- --fall-threshold INT: consecutive failures before demote (default: 3)
- --ttl INT: DNS TTL in seconds (default: 300)
- --cache-propagation FLOAT: resolver/client cache beyond TTL (default: 60)
- --target FLOAT: recovery target in seconds (default: 60)
- --json: machine-readable output
- --report: one paste-ready line for runbook/status report
- --measure-cache HOST: measure real cache hold of a resolver
- --resolver IP: resolver to measure (default: auto)
- --runbook: print operator runbook with step-by-step commands
- --diagnose: print diagnostic decision tree
- (no args): interactive mode

## Exit codes

- 0: within target
- 1: over target
- 2: error (bad path, etc.)

## Design patterns

- Zero dependencies (stdlib only)
- Single file (failover_budget.py)
- MIT license
- --report mode for paste-ready output
- Plain-word explanations for every term
- Exit code 0/1 for CI integration
